description: This file implements a MIDI manager for macOS, handling MIDI device enumeration, connection, data sending, and notification processing using CoreMIDI API.

classes.name: MidiManagerMac
classes.description: A macOS-specific implementation of MidiManager, managing MIDI device connections and data transfer.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new MidiManager for macOS.

methods.name: StartInitialization
methods.description: Begins the initialization process, setting up CoreMIDI client and ports.

methods.name: DispatchSendMidiData
methods.description: Schedules sending MIDI data to a specified port.

methods.name: InitializeCoreMIDI
methods.description: Initializes CoreMIDI client, ports, and device connections.

methods.name: CompleteCoreMIDIInitialization
methods.description: Completes the initialization process after CoreMIDI setup.

methods.name: ReceiveMidiNotify
methods.description: Handles MIDI device connection and disconnection notifications.

methods.name: ReadMidiDispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming MIDI packets on a separate thread.

methods.name: SendMidiData
methods.description: Sends MIDI data to a specified destination port.
